avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Spironolactone reduces urinary potassium excretion; additive effect increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated unless serum K+ is low; require baseline and periodic K+ monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: ACE inhibitors/ARBs (as supplements or concurrent)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both drugs increase serum potassium through different renal mechanisms
avoid_supplements.action: Use only under close medical supervision with frequent K+ and renal function monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and increase potassium retention; impair diuretic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid chronic use; if necessary, use lowest dose for shortest duration with K+ monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Licorice causes sodium retention and potassium wasting; may antagonize spironolactone efficacy and increase hypokalemia risk in combined use
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; monitor blood pressure and potassium levels if exposure occurs

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing spironolactone levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects (gynecomastia, hyperkalemia); inform provider of use

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4, potentially decreasing spironolactone efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and edema control; adjust spironolactone dose if needed

avoid_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, potatoes, tomatoes, avocados, nuts)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Dietary potassium combined with potassium-sparing diuretic significantly increases hyperkalemia risk
avoid_foods.action: Counsel on moderate potassium intake; restrict if serum K+ > 5.0 mEq/L or renal function impaired

avoid_foods.name: Salt substitutes (potassium chloride-based)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Direct potassium source; additive effect with spironolactone causes severe hyperkalemia risk
avoid_foods.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to use standard salt or potassium-free alternatives

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase spironolactone plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid; if consumed regularly, monitor for increased side effects

monitoring_notes: Baseline and periodic monitoring of serum potassium (especially within first week and after dose changes), renal function (creatinine, eGFR), and sodium is essential. Educate patient on hyperkalemia symptoms (weakness, palpitations, irregular heartbeat) and dietary potassium restriction.
